content.text: Sup
Watching game. You
Not. Put MLB Net on, figured there might be a game on. Glad to see you’re back
Me too man
So do you gotta drive to Toledo every day or can you throw at Comerica
I’m throwing sim game there tomorrow but I’m not sure until the team gets back
Ok. Do you think there’s a chance they could bring you back for the fifth game? I’m trying to figure out this rotation
One sec, let me do the math myself
I would imagine no
But if you’re throwing tomorrow, that would put you on regular rest for that spot, but .... You’re right
I bet they’ll probably want you to at least throw a couple sim games or like an intra-squad game in taxi land or something
I really don’t know. The convo I had with Andy and what gardy said to the paper was very different
Don’t repeat this
I’m not. I don’t cover the Tigers anymore. Don’t repeat that
Oh wow
Yeah, we’ll talk at some point. It was just time. I feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders, man, not gonna lie.
Yeah we haven’t been good
It’s not that. Shit, I’d stick it out for another 60 games because I think you guys are going to be good, soon.
Yeah I agree
You just get to a point where you gotta keep moving. I’m not in a great spot career-wise - last year beat me up pretty good - and honestly, dude, the job isn’t going to be the same anymore
Yeah especially this year
Like, part of the job was going in there and bullshitting with you guys. I don’t know if that’s coming back, just gonna be real
It will at some point
But might be a bit
Yep. If I were the players, I’d probably say no. We just stand around in there all the time anyways lol
Haha that’s true
Anyways, just wanted to check in. White Sox scout was wondering how you guys were going to line up in the rotation
Time will tell
And thanks again for being accessible recently, I appreciate the trust. Those are the best moments of the job. I’m gonna keep bugging ya, though
No worries. I got bitched out so you better thank me 😂🙄
What did they have an issue with
You speaking out and using your freedom
It’s a long story. But I ironed it out
Good. I checked with someone before I wrote it about the throwing against a fence thing. I mean, I know that they told you not to but I thought it was pretty innocuous
I was just like, I’m not gonna put that if he’s gonna get in trouble
No it wasn’t even that
They tried to tell me I lied about my symptoms
Oh
They knew I was throwing the whole time
I know lol
It would’ve been malpractice if you weren’t throwing
You’re a professional baseball player. This is what you do to get ready for the season
How would I explain that to my teammates that I wasn’t ready after a month off
How would you explain to yourself
Exactly. But yeah it wasn’t that
“Tigers manager Ron Gardenhire, at the request of pitching coach Rick Anderson, pumped the brakes a little bit on Norris making a quick return.”
This is what you mean
Yeah
But not why I got bitched out. That was from the training staff
Oh yeah
But idk why that’s at the request of Andy. Andy told me the opposite of pumping brakes
.... Gardy might just be playing it coy
Sure hope so
He might not want to say full speed ahead
Because then we write it
Bc they’ve still not said anything to me about pumping brakes
And then maybe you feel a little sore tomorrow and they’re like let’s give him one more turn
And then we make a big deal out of it
Yeah playing by ear
What’s wrong with Norris does he have corona gain
Laughed at “What’s wrong with Norris does he have corona gain”
Hahaha
